module: Flowgraph node "Traffic Signals Settings" (once_instant, depends on core_trafficSignals). Pins: signalsActive (core_trafficSignals.setActive) and simpleLights (debugLevel 1 if true, otherwise 0: simple state visuals). On stop, reactivates the signals and resets debugLevel to 0.

_executionStopped.desc: Reactivates the signals and resets core_trafficSignals.debugLevel to 0.

workOnce.desc: Applies signalsActive and simpleLights if not nil.
